title: fix(api): prevent file descriptor leak in quadlet uploads
body:
## Problem

`processMultipartQuadlets()` can leak file descriptors when processing multipart
quadlet uploads.

The function currently defers `part.Close()` and `file.Close()` inside the loop
that processes each uploaded file. These deferred calls are only executed when
`processMultipartQuadlets()` returns, so all opened files remain open while the
rest of the multipart request is being processed.

For requests containing a large number of quadlet files, this can exhaust the
available file descriptors and cause the request to fail with `too many open
files`.

## Fix

Move the processing of each multipart part into a separate helper function.
The helper closes both the multipart part and the created file before returning,
so only the current file remains open while processing the request.

This keeps the existing behavior and error handling unchanged while preventing
file descriptors from accumulating across uploaded parts.

## Testing

- Added a regression test covering large multipart uploads with a low file
  descriptor limit.
- Verified the test fails with the old implementation due to `too many open
  files`.
- Verified the test passes with the fix.
- Ran the `pkg/api/handlers/...` test suite.
- Ran `gofumpt`.
- Ran `golangci-lint`.
